types.name: CreatePasswordResetTokenResponse
types.description: The data returned when issuing a password reset token.

children.name: jti
children.description:
The opaque token identifier. The caller is responsible for embedding it
as the `jti` claim of the reset JWT.

children.name: expires_at
children.description: The absolute expiration time of the stored token row.
